section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 30, Häggeby-Skokloster
section.notes: Second stage on the separate Bålsta-Skokloster branch; continues from Etapp 29 at Häggeby and hands off to Etapp 31/Skokloster loops at Skokloster slott.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 30 GPX as primary geometry.
Preserve both GPX segments; the second segment is the short final approach into the Skokloster/slott area.
Snap Etapp 29 handoff at Häggeby; Etapp 31 starts at the Skokloster parking/castle area but not exactly on the Etapp 30 GPX endpoint.
qa: Computed length 9.395 km matches official 9.5 km.
No within-segment simplification step exceeds 500 m.
Start is Häggeby kyrka; end is Skokloster slott/slottspark area.
